title: Python urllib.parse.urljoin
notes: Standard-library resolution, parsing both strings in each call. Under PyPy urljoin uses urlsplit's 128-entry lru_cache (CPython 3.14 does not), so only the repeated dot-only references hit it.
details: Standard-library resolution of a reference against a base, parsing both strings inside each call. Under PyPy, urljoin goes through urlsplit's 128-entry lru_cache (CPython 3.14's urljoin does not); one pass over the fixtures has more distinct strings than that, so only the repeated dot-only references are served from it.
